main_text.p: Imò impietas est, diis habitū honorem,& eius honoris ministrum, quasi[?]que sacerdotē uiolare. D. An impietatis nomine iniuria ministro curatoriq; diuinorum ludorū facta contineatur? Alterū exemplum. Aestiuo tempore adolescentes urbani, cum Oftiam uenissent, litus ingressi, piscatores trahentes retia adierunt: & pepigerūt, bolum quanti emerent, numos soluerunt, diu expectauerūt dum retia extraherentur. aliquando extractis piscis nullus infuit, sed sporta auri obsuta: tum emptores bolum suum aiunt. Haec Suetonius in li-

page.notes: The quotation marks („) at the start of each line on the right are typographic marks of the quoted passage and are not transcribed as text. The left-margin handwriting is not printed and is excluded. The running head title is in heavy type and not legible on the scan. "quasi[?]que" is uncertain: the scan reads "quafíque". The page ends mid-word with "li-", which continues on the next page.
